sourceText: Operator (2026-07-05): approved starting the proof-or-stop evidence-instrument replay & tamper campaign, with the instruction to first write a supporting document stating milestones, purpose, what is proven, evidence, and why — then land it and begin implementation. Operator also decided the cross-vendor question: Codex serves as red-team/audit/replication, never as outcome judge (deterministic code judges).
normalizedOutcome: The reviewed rev 3 execution plan (5 core milestones M0-M4 + optional M5, three-state hypotheses H1-H4, tamper fingerprint discipline, cross-vendor section 6.5, no-overclaim rule) is committed at docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-instrument-replay-execution-plan.md as the campaign's pre-registration, doc-only.
acceptanceClaim: git show HEAD:docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-instrument-replay-execution-plan.md matches the reviewed rev 3 text (sha256 == recorded backup digest), contains sections 1-12 incl. 6.5 and the M0-M5 milestone table, and git diff main...HEAD touches exactly that one path.
